name: Numerically generated black carbon fractal aggregate optical properties dataset
model_or_instrument: Multiple Sphere T-Matrix Method (MSTM) and cluster-cluster algorithm
size_as_stated: 57,556 numerically generated aggregates for Ns < 100; 880 aggregates in the size range 100 < Ns < 1000
resolution: monomer radii 7–72 nm (at 450 nm) and 10–104 nm (at 650 nm)
